# Stdlib keyword resolves through the import pipeline.
sngl doc sngl
stdout 'Standard Library'
stdout 'button'

# Stdlib decl lookup.
sngl doc sngl button
stdout '# button'

# An alias declared in the CWD's package resolves to the imported directory.
sngl doc w
stdout 'Counter'

# Local directory still indexes as before.
sngl doc ./widgets
stdout 'Counter'

# Unknown scheme surfaces an error (nonzero exit).
! sngl doc bogus://nope

-- app.sngl --
import w "./widgets"
component main {
    w.Counter(count = 1)
}
-- widgets/widgets.sngl --
component Counter(count int) {
    text { value = "count: ${count}" }
}
